claim: AD Connector is an Active Directory proxy for AWS created applications and services only; no third-party applications work with AD Connector.
question: Can third-party applications use AD Connector to reach an on-premises Active Directory?

values.display: for AWS created applications and services only
There are no third-party applications that work with AD Connector

evidence.quote: As an alternative to AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory ([AWS Managed Microsoft AD](directory_microsoft_ad.md)), AD Connector is an Active Directory proxy for AWS created applications and services only.
There are no third-party applications that work with AD Connector.

qualifiers.scope: EC2 seamless domain join with AD Connector

claim: AD Connector can authenticate AWS Management Console users with their Active Directory credentials without setting up SAML infrastructure.
question: Can on-premises AD users sign in to the AWS console through AD Connector without a SAML IdP?

evidence.quote: + AWS Management Console – You can use AD Connector to authenticate AWS Management Console users with their Active Directory credentials without setting up SAML infrastructure. For more information, see [Enabling AWS Management Console access with AWS Managed Microsoft AD credentials](ms_ad_management_console_access.md).

claim: An EC2 instance can be seamlessly joined to the AWS Managed Microsoft AD domain when it is launched, or launched and joined from the Directory Service console with AWS Systems Manager Automation.
question: How are EC2 instances joined to an AWS Managed Microsoft AD domain?

values.display: seamlessly join an Amazon EC2 instance

qualifiers.scope: AWS Managed Microsoft AD domain join

evidence.quote: You can seamlessly join an Amazon EC2 instance to your Active Directory domain when the instance is launched.

You can also launch an EC2 instance and join it to an Active Directory domain directly from the Directory Service console with [AWS Systems Manager Automation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-automation.html).
